_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the OpenRA eggs in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: OpenRA
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: OpenRA, the open-source remake of the classic Command & Conquer games. Runs a dedicated server for Red Alert, Tiberian Dawn or Dune 2000.
startup: exec ./squashfs-root/AppRun --server Server.Name="{{SERVER_NAME}}" Server.ListenPort={{SERVER_PORT}} Server.AdvertiseOnline={{PUBLIC}} Server.EnableSingleplayer={{SINGLEPLAYER}} Server.Password="{{PASSWORD}}" Server.RequireAuthentication={{AUTH}} Server.EnableGeoIP={{GEOIP}} Server.ShareAnonymizedIPs={{ANONYMOUS}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# OpenRA: downloads the chosen mod's AppImage (Red Alert, Tiberian Dawn or
# Dune 2000) from OpenRA's GitHub releases and unpacks it. Maps, replays
# and settings in .config/openra are never touched, and the game is
# replaced only once the new one has unpacked.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

repo=OpenRA/OpenRA
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || fail "OpenRA's Linux server only runs on x86_64 (amd64) nodes."
case "${MOD:-ra}" in
    ra) name=Red-Alert ;;
    cnc) name=Tiberian-Dawn ;;
    d2k) name=Dune-2000 ;;
    *) fail "Mod must be ra (Red Alert), cnc (Tiberian Dawn) or d2k (Dune 2000)." ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo") || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
else
    tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want" 2>/dev/null) ||
        fail "OpenRA has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $(gh-release tag "$repo" 2>/dev/null || echo release-20250330)."
fi
asset="OpenRA-$name-x86_64.AppImage"

if [ -x squashfs-root/AppRun ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag $MOD" ]; then
    echo "OpenRA $tag ($name) is already installed."
else
    mkdir -p "$build"
    echo "Downloading OpenRA $tag ($name)"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/openra.AppImage" || fail "OpenRA $tag has no $name download."
    chmod +x "$build/openra.AppImage"
    (cd "$build" && ./openra.AppImage --appimage-extract >/dev/null) || fail "The AppImage couldn't be unpacked."
    rm -rf squashfs-root
    mv "$build/squashfs-root" squashfs-root
    echo "$tag $MOD" > .raptor-version
fi
echo "Installed OpenRA $tag ($name)."

variables.name: Mod
variables.description: The game to host: ra (Red Alert), cnc (Tiberian Dawn) or d2k (Dune 2000). Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The OpenRA release, such as release-20250330, or latest for the newest one. Players need the same version. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players need to join. Leave it empty for none.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: List the server in the public server browser.

variables.name: Require accounts
variables.description: Only let players with an OpenRA forum account join.

variables.name: Singleplayer
variables.description: Let a game start with only one player.

variables.name: GeoIP
variables.description: Show each player's country in the lobby.

variables.name: Anonymized IPs
variables.description: Show players only part of each other's IP addresses.
